content: VERIFIED from official docs (neon.com/docs/connect/connection-pooling, fetched 2026-09-08): Neon PgBouncer runs ONLY transaction mode; pooled connections do not support SET/RESET session vars, LISTEN/NOTIFY, WITH HOLD cursors, SQL-level PREPARE/DEALLOCATE, PRESERVE/DELETE temp tables, session advisory locks. Migrations and pg_dump/restore MUST use the direct (non -pooler) endpoint. max_connections by compute: 0.25CU=104 (7 reserved), 0.5CU=209, 1CU=419; default_pool_size=0.9 times max_connections; query_wait_timeout=120s; not user-configurable. Protocol-level prepared statements OK since PgBouncer 1.22.
